
#[repr(C)]#[derive(Clone,Copy)]pub enum Mode { A=3, B=19 }
#[repr(i8)]#[derive(Clone,Copy)]pub enum Signed { A=-7, B=101 }
#[repr(u16)]#[derive(Clone,Copy)]pub enum Unsigned { A=7, B=65000 }
#[repr(C)]#[derive(Clone,Copy)]pub struct Callbacks { cb: Option<extern "C" fn(u64)->u64>, mode: Mode }

extern "C" fn plus_local(x:u64)->u64 { x+13 }
extern "C" fn local_nullable(x:Option<extern "C" fn(u64)->u64>)->Option<extern "C" fn(u64)->u64> { if x.is_some() { None } else { Some(plus_local) } }
extern "C" fn local_signed(x:Signed)->Signed { match x { Signed::A=>Signed::B, Signed::B=>Signed::A } }
#[repr(C)]#[derive(Clone, Copy)]struct Words { words: [u64; 2] }
#[repr(C)]#[derive(Clone, Copy)]struct Padded { lead: u8, payload: u64, tail: u16 }
#[repr(C)]#[derive(Clone, Copy)]struct Small { a: u8, b: u16, c: u32 }
#[repr(C)]#[derive(Clone, Copy)]struct Nested { prefix: u16, small: Small, words: Words }
#[repr(C)]#[derive(Clone, Copy)]struct Big { words: [u64; 5] }
unsafe extern "C" {
    fn dlopen(path: *const i8, mode: i32) -> *mut u8;
    fn dlsym(handle: *mut u8, name: *const i8) -> *mut u8;
}
extern "C" fn identity<T>(value: T) -> T { value }
extern "C" fn local_words(mut value: Words) -> Words { value.words[0] += 1; value }
extern "C" fn observe(value: Words, _: u64) -> u64 { value.words[0] }
extern "C" fn local_padded(mut value: Padded) -> Padded { value.lead += 1; value.payload += 2; value.tail += 3; value }
extern "C" fn from_pointer(value: *const Words) -> Words {
    let mut copy = unsafe { *value }; copy.words[0] += 7; copy
}
fn rust_words(value: Words) -> Words { value }
#[repr(C)]
struct Node { next: *const [Node; 1] }
extern "C" fn inspect_node(value: Node) -> u64 { if value.next.is_null() { 42 } else { 0 } }
fn main() {
    assert_eq!(inspect_node(Node { next: core::ptr::null() }), 42);
    let indirect: extern "C" fn(Node) -> u64 = inspect_node;
    assert_eq!(indirect(Node { next: core::ptr::null() }), 42);
    let mut value = Words { words: [17, 25] };
    let direct = identity(value);
    let changed = local_words(value);
    assert_eq!(value.words[0], 17);
    assert_eq!(direct.words[0], 17); assert_eq!(changed.words[0], 18);
    assert_eq!(observe(value, { value.words[0] = 99; 0 }), 17);
    value = from_pointer(&value as *const Words);
    assert_eq!(value.words[0], 106);
    let rust: fn(Words) -> Words = rust_words;
    assert_eq!(rust(value).words[0], 106);
    assert_eq!(rust_words(value).words[1], 25);
    unsafe {
        let lib = dlopen(c"__LIBRARY__".as_ptr(), 2); assert!(!lib.is_null());

        let mode:unsafe extern "C" fn(Mode)->Mode=core::mem::transmute(dlsym(lib,c"enum_mode".as_ptr()));
        assert_eq!(mode(Mode::A) as i32,19); assert_eq!(mode(Mode::B) as i32,3);
        let signed:unsafe extern "C" fn(Signed)->Signed=core::mem::transmute(dlsym(lib,c"enum_signed".as_ptr()));
        assert_eq!(signed(Signed::B) as i8,-7);
        let unsigned:unsafe extern "C" fn(Unsigned)->Unsigned=core::mem::transmute(dlsym(lib,c"enum_unsigned".as_ptr()));
        assert_eq!(unsigned(Unsigned::A) as u16,65000);
        let unsafe_cb:unsafe extern "C" fn(Option<unsafe extern "C" fn(u64)->u64>)->Option<unsafe extern "C" fn(u64)->u64>=core::mem::transmute(dlsym(lib,c"nullable_unsafe".as_ptr()));
        let got=unsafe_cb(None).unwrap(); assert_eq!(got(11),34);assert!(unsafe_cb(Some(got)).is_none());
        let nullable:unsafe extern "C" fn(Option<extern "C" fn(u64)->u64>)->Option<extern "C" fn(u64)->u64>=core::mem::transmute(dlsym(lib,c"nullable".as_ptr()));
        assert_eq!(nullable(None).unwrap()(11),18); assert!(nullable(Some(plus_local)).is_none());
        let invoke:unsafe extern "C" fn(extern "C" fn(Option<extern "C" fn(u64)->u64>)->Option<extern "C" fn(u64)->u64>)->u64=core::mem::transmute(dlsym(lib,c"invoke_nullable".as_ptr()));
        assert_eq!(invoke(local_nullable),24);
        let enum_cb:unsafe extern "C" fn(extern "C" fn(Signed)->Signed)->i8=core::mem::transmute(dlsym(lib,c"enum_callback".as_ptr()));
        assert_eq!(enum_cb(local_signed),101);
        let record:unsafe extern "C" fn(Callbacks)->u64=core::mem::transmute(dlsym(lib,c"callback_record".as_ptr()));
        assert_eq!(record(Callbacks{cb:Some(plus_local),mode:Mode::B}),32);
        let sum: unsafe extern "C" fn(Words) -> u64 = core::mem::transmute(dlsym(lib, c"sum_words".as_ptr()));
        let call: unsafe extern "C" fn(extern "C" fn(Words) -> Words) -> u64 = core::mem::transmute(dlsym(lib, c"call_words".as_ptr()));
        assert_eq!(call(identity::<Words>), 42);
        assert_eq!(call(local_words), 43);
        let sum2: unsafe extern "C" fn(Words) -> u64 = sum;
        assert_eq!(sum2(Words { words: [17,25] }), 42);
        let padded: unsafe extern "C" fn(Padded) -> Padded = core::mem::transmute(dlsym(lib, c"padded".as_ptr()));
        let p = padded(Padded { lead: 3, payload: 1000, tail: 7 });
        assert_eq!(p.lead, 6); assert_eq!(p.payload, 1017); assert_eq!(p.tail, 12);
        let call_padded: unsafe extern "C" fn(extern "C" fn(Padded) -> Padded) -> u64 = core::mem::transmute(dlsym(lib, c"call_padded".as_ptr()));
        assert_eq!(call_padded(identity::<Padded>), 1010);
        assert_eq!(call_padded(local_padded), 1016);
        let small: unsafe extern "C" fn(Small) -> Small = core::mem::transmute(dlsym(lib, c"small".as_ptr()));
        let s = small(Small { a: 3, b: 1000, c: 2000 });
        assert_eq!(s.a, 4); assert_eq!(s.b, 1002); assert_eq!(s.c, 2003);
        let nested: unsafe extern "C" fn(Nested) -> Nested = core::mem::transmute(dlsym(lib, c"nested".as_ptr()));
        let n = nested(Nested { prefix: 13, small: s, words: value });
        assert_eq!(n.prefix, 14); assert_eq!(n.small.c, 2010); assert_eq!(n.words.words[1], 34);
        let big: unsafe extern "C" fn(Big) -> Big = core::mem::transmute(dlsym(lib, c"big".as_ptr()));
        let original = Big { words: [3, 5, 7, 11, 13] }; let b = big(original);
        assert_eq!(original.words[0], 3); assert_eq!(b.words[0], 14); assert_eq!(b.words[4], 26);
        let scalar: unsafe extern "C" fn(i8, u16) -> i64 = core::mem::transmute(dlsym(lib, c"scalar".as_ptr()));
        assert_eq!(scalar(-7, 65000), 64993);
        println!("{} {} {} {} {}", sum(value), p.payload, n.small.c, b.words[4], scalar(-7,65000));
    }
}
